title: Manage
description: Write, schedule and publish announcements, events, polls, quick links, documents and the wiki.
descriptionDepartmentAuthor: Write and publish announcements, events and documents for {department}.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: News for everyone, a department, a team or certain roles.

events.title: Events
events.description: Dates in the calendar, with RSVP if you like.

polls.title: Polls
polls.description: Questions with answers to vote on.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Files for the library: policies, forms, templates and guides.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.description: Spaces, who reads them, and the drafts and schedules of every page. The counts are pages.

detail.notPublished: Not published: readers do not see it.
detail.changesPending: Changes not published yet: the published version stays as it is until you publish them.

scheduleErrors.windowExpired: its time window had already ended when it was due
scheduleErrors.notPublishable: the draft could not be published as it stood
scheduleErrors.retryExhausted: the intranet could not publish it after several attempts

confirm.publishBody: Readers see it from now on.
confirm.unpublishBody: Readers no longer see it. The draft stays, and you can publish it again later.
confirm.discardBody: The draft goes back to the published version. Every change since then is lost.
confirm.deleteBody: Every version is removed, together with its comments, reactions and responses. This cannot be undone.
confirm.closeBody: Voting ends at once. The results stay visible.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The schedule is saved with the draft and takes effect at once, also for a published item.

conflict.title: Changed in the meantime
conflict.body: Someone changed this item after you opened it, possibly in the Strapi admin panel.
conflict.reloadHint: Shows the current version. Your changes are lost; copy your text first if you need it.
conflict.copied: Your text is on the clipboard.
conflict.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select your text in the form and copy it yourself.
conflict.overwriteHint: Saves the fields you changed over the current version; everything else keeps the other changes.

failure.forbidden: You may not do this, or no longer. Reload the page.
failure.notFound: This item no longer exists, or you can no longer edit it.
failure.unshown: The intranet did not accept some values. Reload the page and try again.
failure.conflict: Someone changed this item in the meantime.
failure.unavailable: The intranet cannot be reached right now — please try again in a moment.
failure.failed: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.

errors.confirmAudience: This would show the item to everyone. Tick “Confirm this audience when saving” to do that, or choose a department or team.
errors.invalidInstant: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter a web address that starts with https:// or http://.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must not be before the start.
errors.notMidnight: An all-day event starts and ends at midnight; choose the days again.
errors.scheduleInPast: Choose a time at least one minute from now.
errors.unpublishBeforePublish: The withdrawal must come after the publication.
errors.expiresBeforePublish: The announcement would expire before it is published. Move the publication or the expiry.
errors.notPublishable: This is needed before the item can be published.
errors.frozenAfterVotes: Someone has voted, so this can no longer change.
errors.optionCount: A poll needs between 2 and 20 answers.
errors.fileType: Upload a PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) file, or a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. Files with macros, templates and slide shows are not accepted.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large: up to 20 MB for PDF and Office files, 5 MB for images.
errors.parentCycle: A page cannot be placed below itself or one of its subpages. Choose another parent page.
errors.neverPublished: There is no published version to go back to, so the draft stays. Ask an editor to delete it if it is no longer needed.
errors.timeRepeated: This time occurs twice on this day because of the clock change. Choose another time.
errors.timeSkipped: This time does not exist on this day because of the clock change. Choose another time.

markdown.hint: Markdown: **bold**, _italic_, [link](https://…), lists with “-”. HTML is shown as text.

targeting.optionsFailed: The departments and teams could not be loaded, so the audience cannot be changed right now. Reload the page to try again.
targeting.optionsTruncated: Not every department or team could be loaded; some may be missing.
targeting.retargetNotice: Needs re-targeting: a department or team this item was meant for was deleted. Only editors and admins see it, and it notifies nobody, until you confirm an audience.
targeting.retargetNoTarget: Needs re-targeting: no department or team is selected (none was chosen, or the one it had was deleted). Only editors and admins see it, and it notifies nobody. Choose one, or set the audience to everyone by confirming it below.
targeting.restrictedHint: Choose a department, or tick “Confirm this audience when saving” above to keep the audience as shown.
targeting.everyoneNeedsConfirm: “Everyone” makes this item company-wide: tick “Confirm this audience when saving” above, or choose a department or team.

departmentAuthor.departmentHint: You write for your own department; it is set for you.
departmentAuthor.eventVisibility: Visible to everyone in the calendar; notifies your department.
departmentAuthor.noDepartmentHint: You can write for your department once an administrator has assigned you to one.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The saved version as readers will see it. Save to update the preview.
